The company attributed the change to deferring some multi-client projects as contract work grew. Lower multi-client spend alongside a larger backlog points to a mix shift toward contract work.
items.source_name: TGS Q3 2026 results release

items.headline: Union Pacific: fuel cut Q3 operating ratio by 140 bp; 2026 capital plan $3.5B
items.take: Union Pacific said higher fuel prices unfavorably affected its Q3 operating ratio by 140 basis points, and that its reported 2026 operating ratio is challenged by high fuel prices while the core business is improving. It affirmed high-single-digit reported EPS growth for 2026 and listed a $3.5 billion capital plan as updated. Fuel is the company's own explanation for why the reported operating ratio improved only 10 basis points despite 15% revenue growth.
items.source_name: Union Pacific Q3 2026 earnings release

items.headline: Bank of Korea holds Base Rate at 3.00%, 7-0; September CPI 2.9%
items.take: The Bank of Korea held its Base Rate at 3.00% on Oct. 22 with all seven Monetary Policy Board members in favor. It put September consumer price inflation at 2.9% and core at 2.8%, and said it will set the timing and pace of further increases after reviewing Q3 GDP and October inflation data. A hold paired with language about further increases keeps Seoul on a tightening bias.
items.source_name: Bank of Korea Monetary Policy Decision (Oct. 22, 2026)

items.headline: Turkey's central bank cuts one-week repo rate to 36% from 37%
items.take: The Central Bank of the Republic of Turkiye lowered its one-week repo auction rate by 1 percentage point to 36% on Oct. 22, with the overnight lending rate cut to 39% from 40% and the overnight borrowing rate to 34.5% from 35.5%. The committee said recent figures confirm a deceleration in underlying inflation, but flagged elevated energy prices as an upside risk. The easing is gradual and conditioned on that energy risk.
items.source_name: Central Bank of the Republic of Turkiye press release 2026-45

items.headline: East West Bancorp Q3 net income $382M; diluted EPS $2.76 vs. $2.65
items.take: East West Bancorp reported Q3 2026 total revenue of $823 million versus $778 million a year earlier, up 5.8%. Net income was $382 million versus $368 million, and diluted EPS was $2.76 versus $2.65, up 4.2%. Total loans were $59.7 billion and total deposits $71.5 billion at Sept. 30, so earnings growth ran ahead of revenue growth.
items.source_name: East West Bancorp Q3 2026 earnings release

items.headline: Liberty Energy Q3 revenue $1,196.2M, up 26%; net loss $39.1M
items.take: Liberty Energy reported Q3 2026 revenue of $1,196.2 million versus $947.4 million a year earlier, up 26.3%. It posted a net loss of $39.1 million, or $(0.24) per diluted share, versus net income of $43.1 million, or $0.26; adjusted EBITDA was $141.6 million. Capital expenditures were $621.9 million versus $113.0 million, so spending rose about 5.5x as revenue grew.
items.source_name: Liberty Energy Q3 2026 earnings release

items.headline: Liberty Energy signs development agreement for 1.2 GW of data-center power
items.take: Liberty Energy said a strategic development agreement with a frontier AI lab and an infrastructure platform covers 1.2 GW of integrated power services at data center campuses, with a significant prepayment of capacity fees. It targets execution of a first energy service agreement for about 500 MW by December 2026, with phased energization from Q4 2027 through Q1 2029. The timetable shows revenue from the power build-out is years away, while Q3 capex has already risen.
items.source_name: Liberty Energy Q3 2026 earnings release

items.headline: Lazard Q3: Financial Advisory $470M, Asset Management $357M; $33M buyback
items.take: Lazard's Q3 GAAP net revenue was $470 million in Financial Advisory versus $427 million (up 10%) and $357 million in Asset Management versus $327 million (up 9%). It repurchased $33 million of common stock in the quarter, with about $224 million of authorization remaining at Sept. 30. Both segments grew at similar rates, yet GAAP diluted EPS fell to $0.26 from $0.65.
items.source_name: Lazard Q3 2026 results release

items.headline: American Airlines Q3 revenue $16.3B, up 19.3%; GAAP net loss $269M
items.take: American Airlines reported Q3 total revenue of $16.3 billion versus $13.69 billion a year earlier, up 19.3%. The GAAP net loss was $269 million, or $(0.41) per diluted share, versus a $114 million loss, or $(0.17), in Q3 2025; the adjusted loss was $182 million, or $(0.28) per share. The loss widened despite the revenue gain, with fuel costs a major factor (see separate item).
items.source_name: American Airlines Q3 2026 earnings release (Oct. 22, 2026)

items.headline: American Airlines Q3 jet fuel cost $3.85/gal vs. $2.37; sees Q4 near $4.70
items.take: American's aircraft fuel and related taxes were $4.64 billion in Q3 versus $2.77 billion a year earlier, up 67.5%, at an average of $3.85 per gallon versus $2.37. It expects about $4.70 per gallon in Q4 and guides an adjusted loss of $(1.10) to $(0.50) per share for Q4 and $(1.60) to $(1.00) for 2026. Year-end liquidity was $11.8 billion.
items.source_name: American Airlines Q3 2026 earnings release (Oct. 22, 2026)

items.headline: Southern Copper Q3 net sales $4.70B, up 39.1%; diluted EPS $2.15 vs. $1.32
items.take: Southern Copper reported 3Q26 net sales of $4,696.6 million versus $3,377.3 million in 3Q25, up 39.1%. Net income attributable to the company was $1,801.8 million versus $1,107.6 million, up 62.7%, and diluted EPS was $2.15 versus $1.32. Mined copper production was 232,396 tonnes versus 234,892 tonnes, down 1.1%, so the revenue gain came without higher copper output.
items.source_name: Southern Copper 3Q26 earnings release (Oct. 20, 2026, SEC Form 8-K Ex. 99.1)

items.headline: Southern Copper Q3 capex $515.8M, up 47.7%; quarterly dividend $1.30
items.take: Southern Copper spent $515.8 million on capital investments in 3Q26 versus $349.2 million in 3Q25, up 47.7% and equal to 28.6% of quarterly net income. The board authorized a $1.30 per share cash dividend plus a stock dividend of 0.0106 shares per share, payable Nov. 19 to holders of record Nov. 3. Mined zinc output fell 7.9% to 41,880 tonnes.
items.source_name: Southern Copper 3Q26 earnings release (Oct. 20, 2026, SEC Form 8-K Ex. 99.1)

items.headline: Alaska Air Q3 revenue $4.31B, up 14%; GAAP loss $1.32/share; fuel $3.94/gal
items.take: Alaska Air Group reported Q3 total operating revenue of $4,308 million versus $3,766 million a year earlier, up 14%. GAAP net loss was $147 million, or $(1.32) per share, versus net income of $73 million, or $0.62, while aircraft fuel expense rose 60% to $1,214 million. It guides a full-year 2026 adjusted loss of $(5.50) to $(5.00) per share, including $1.8 billion of fuel expense above plan.
items.source_name: Alaska Air Group Q3 2026 earnings release (Oct. 20, 2026)

items.headline: Tractor Supply Q3 net sales $3.91B, up 5.1%; diluted EPS $0.43 vs. $0.49
items.take: Tractor Supply reported Q3 net sales of $3.91 billion versus $3.72 billion a year earlier, with comparable store sales up 0.4% versus up 3.9% in Q3 2025. Net income was $224.7 million versus $259.3 million, and diluted EPS was $0.43 versus $0.49. Sales growth outpaced the comparable-store gain, so the increase came mainly from outside the existing-store base.
items.source_name: Tractor Supply Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Form 8-K, Ex. 99.1)

items.headline: Tractor Supply reaffirms 2026 outlook; returned $213.4M to holders in Q3
items.take: Tractor Supply reaffirmed fiscal 2026 guidance of net sales growth of 2.5% to 3.5%, comparable store sales of (1%) to flat, and diluted EPS of $1.78 to $1.88 (adjusted $1.90 to $2.00). In Q3 it repurchased about 2.7 million shares for $88.5 million and paid $124.9 million in dividends. The guided comparable-sales range implies little same-store growth for the full year.
items.source_name: Tractor Supply Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Form 8-K, Ex. 99.1)

items.headline: Cencora agrees to acquire rest of American Oncology Network; EV $2.4B
items.take: Cencora agreed to acquire all equity interests in American Oncology Network (AON) that it does not already own, at an enterprise value of $2.4 billion: $2.3 billion at closing plus contingent value rights of up to $100 million. Cencora holds about 4% today; assuming a 25% stockholder rollover it expects to pay about $1.7 billion to reach 75% ownership. Closing is subject to regulatory clearances and AON stockholder approval.
items.source_name: Cencora press release (Oct. 21, 2026)

items.headline: Kering Q3 revenue €3,345M, stable reported, -1% comparable; Gucci -6% comparable
items.take: Kering reported Q3 2026 revenue of €3,345 million versus €3,331 million in Q3 2025 (restated to exclude Kering Beauté), stable on a reported basis and down 1% comparable. Gucci revenue was €1,291 million versus €1,343 million, down 4% reported and 6% comparable. Nine-month revenue was €10,565 million, down 2% reported and flat comparable, so Gucci is the main drag within the group figure.
items.source_name: Kering Q3 2026 revenue release (GlobeNewswire, company release)

items.headline: Treasury week ahead: 2-, 5- and 7-year note auctions Oct. 26, 27 and 29
items.take: Treasury's tentative schedule lists 2-year notes on Monday Oct. 26, 5-year notes on Tuesday Oct. 27 and 7-year notes on Thursday Oct. 29, all settling Monday Nov. 2, plus a 2-year FRN on Wed. Oct. 28. The 5-year TIPS auction is scheduled today, Oct. 22, settling Oct. 30. The three-note run is concentrated in four days, and dates are tentative until Treasury's formal announcements.
items.source_name: U.S. Treasury Tentative Auction Schedule

items.headline: Dow Q3 net sales $11.3B, up 13%; GAAP EPS $0.62 vs. $0.08
items.take: Dow reported Q3 net sales of $11,267M versus $9,973M a year earlier, GAAP diluted EPS of $0.62 versus $0.08, and operating EPS of $0.71 versus $(0.19). Operating EPS excludes significant items totaling $0.09 per share. The swing in operating EPS from a loss to a profit is the main change versus Q3 2025.
items.source_name: Dow Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Form 8-K, Ex. 99.1)

items.headline: Dow cash from operations $1.84B in Q3 vs. $1.13B; $253M paid in dividends
items.take: Dow reported Q3 cash flow from operations (continuing operations) of $1,839M versus $1,130M in Q3 2025; nine-month cash from operations was $4,287M versus $764M. The company returned $253M in dividends in the quarter and said it is on track for the upsized $700M in growth and productivity benefits in 2026. The nine-month comparison shows how much of the improvement is year-to-date rather than a single quarter.
items.source_name: Dow Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Form 8-K, Ex. 99.1)

items.headline: Rollins Q3 revenue $1.09B, up 6.2%; diluted EPS $0.33 vs. $0.34
items.take: Rollins reported Q3 revenues of $1,089.7M versus $1,026.1M, with organic revenues up 4.4%. Net income was $157.9M versus $163.5M and diluted EPS was $0.33 versus $0.34; adjusted EPS was $0.34 versus $0.35. Reported growth outpaced organic growth, while earnings per share slipped slightly.
items.source_name: Rollins Q3 2026 earnings release (PR Newswire)

items.headline: Rollins commercial revenue up 7.7%; operating cash flow $242M, up 26.4%
items.take: Rollins said Q3 residential revenue was $499.7M (up 4.9%, organic 2.3%), commercial $360.7M (up 7.7%, organic 6.6%), and termite and ancillary $217.9M (up 6.5%, organic 5.3%). Operating cash flow was $242M, up 26.4%, and included a $63M benefit from the timing of a tax refund. Commercial showed the strongest organic growth of the three lines.
items.source_name: Rollins Q3 2026 earnings release (PR Newswire)

items.headline: Visteon Q3 sales $970M; $77M warranty charges; EBITDA guide lowered to $370M-$410M
items.take: Visteon reported Q3 net sales of $970M versus $917M and net income attributable to Visteon of $5M, or $0.19 per diluted share, versus a $(0.40) loss per share. Adjusted EBITDA was $46M including $77M of exceptional warranty charges. It raised 2026 sales guidance to $3.80B-$3.85B and set adjusted EBITDA at $370M-$410M, a range the release describes as lowered.
items.source_name: Visteon Q3 2026 earnings release (PR Newswire)

items.headline: Freddie Mac: 30-year mortgage rate averages 7.32%, down from 7.40%
items.take: Freddie Mac's Primary Mortgage Market Survey for Oct. 22 showed the 30-year fixed-rate mortgage averaging 7.32%, versus 7.40% last week and 6.19% a year ago. The 15-year averaged 6.68%, versus 6.71% last week and 5.44% a year ago. The weekly decline is 8 basis points, while the 30-year rate remains 113 basis points above its year-ago level.
items.source_name: Freddie Mac PMMS release (GlobeNewswire)

items.headline: Philip Morris Q3 net revenue $11.4B; adjusted EPS $2.36, reported $2.12
items.take: Philip Morris International reported Q3 2026 net revenues of $11,438M versus $10,845M a year earlier, up 5.5% (7.1% organically). Reported diluted EPS was $2.12 versus $2.23, down 4.9%, while adjusted diluted EPS was $2.36 versus $2.24, up 5.4%. The company's full-year adjusted diluted EPS forecast is $8.29 to $8.44, and reported EPS moved in the opposite direction from adjusted EPS in the quarter.
items.source_name: Philip Morris International Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Form 8-K)

items.headline: Allegion Q3 revenue $1.17B, up 9.6%; adjusted EPS $2.60
items.take: Allegion reported Q3 2026 revenue of $1,172.6M versus $1,070.2M, up 9.6% reported and 7.2% organic. Reported diluted EPS was $2.59 versus $2.18, and adjusted EPS was $2.60 versus $2.30. The 2026 outlook calls for adjusted EPS of $9.05 to $9.10 and organic revenue growth of 5.0% to 6.0%.
items.source_name: Allegion Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Form 8-K)

items.headline: Snap-on Q3 net sales $1.18B; diluted EPS $4.64 versus $5.02
items.take: Snap-on reported Q3 2026 net sales of $1,183.7M versus $1,190.8M, with organic sales down 2.8% and acquisitions adding $25.6M. Diluted EPS was $4.64 versus $5.02; the year-ago quarter included a $22.0M benefit, or $0.31 per diluted share after tax, from the settlement of a legal matter. Operating earnings before financial services were $248.1M, or 21.0% of net sales, versus $278.5M, or 23.4%.
items.source_name: Snap-on Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Form 8-K)

items.headline: CBRE Q3 revenue $11.5B, up 13%; GAAP EPS $1.52, core EPS $2.05
items.take: CBRE reported Q3 2026 revenue of $11,517M versus $10,221M a year earlier, GAAP diluted EPS of $1.52 versus $1.21 and core EPS of $2.05 versus $1.60. Net income attributable to CBRE was $443M versus $363M. Per-share earnings grew faster than revenue, showing profit growth outpacing the top line in the quarter.
items.source_name: CBRE Q3 2026 earnings release (Business Wire)

items.headline: CBRE: critical infrastructure services revenue up 80%; property sales up 28%
items.take: CBRE said Q3 2026 revenue from critical infrastructure services rose 80% in the Building Operations & Experience segment, citing data center services and the Pearce Services acquisition. Global property sales revenue rose 28% (29% in local currency), with U.S. sales up 37%, and year-to-date share repurchases were nearly $1.2B. Data center-related activity and transaction volumes both contributed to the quarter.
items.source_name: CBRE Q3 2026 earnings release (Business Wire)

items.headline: Southwest Q3 revenue $8.42B, up 21%; diluted EPS $0.55 vs. $0.10
items.take: Southwest Airlines reported Q3 2026 operating revenues of $8,422M versus $6,949M, operating income of $379M versus $35M, and net income of $270M versus $54M. Diluted EPS was $0.55 versus $0.10 and adjusted diluted EPS was $0.66 versus $0.11, with unit revenue up 21.6% to 18.55 cents. The operating margin was 4.5%, up 4.0 points, so profit rose from a low base alongside the revenue gain.
items.source_name: Southwest Airlines Q3 2026 earnings release (PR Newswire)

items.headline: Southwest guides Q4 adjusted EPS $0.55-$0.80; full-year $2.60-$2.85
items.take: Southwest guided Q4 2026 adjusted EPS to $0.55-$0.80 and full-year 2026 adjusted EPS to $2.60-$2.85, based on the forward fuel curve as of Oct. 15, 2026. It expects Q4 unit revenue up 19%-21%, capacity up 3%-4% and CASM-X up 4.0%-4.5%, with 2026 net capital spending of $2.5B-$2.75B. Guided revenue per seat-mile growth well above cost growth is the key swing factor in the Q4 range.
items.source_name: Southwest Airlines Q3 2026 earnings release (PR Newswire)

items.headline: Comcast Q3 revenue $29.3B; diluted EPS $0.97 vs. $0.90, adjusted $1.07
items.take: Comcast reported Q3 2026 revenue of $29,298M versus $31,198M a year earlier (up 0.5% pro forma), net income attributable to Comcast of $3,448M, diluted EPS of $0.97 versus $0.90 and adjusted EPS of $1.07 versus $1.12. Adjusted EBITDA was $9,106M versus $9,669M and free cash flow $4,211M versus $4,945M. GAAP earnings rose while adjusted EPS and cash flow fell, a gap that shows the reported and underlying pictures diverging this quarter.
items.source_name: Comcast Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Form 8-K, Exhibit 99.1)

items.headline: Comcast loses 144,000 broadband customers in Q3; buyback suspended
items.take: Comcast reported domestic broadband residential customers fell by 144,000 in Q3 2026 versus a loss of 91,000 a year earlier, while domestic wireless lines rose by 368,000 versus 414,000. It paid $1.2B in dividends and said it suspended its share repurchase program beginning in the third quarter, with the pause expected to continue through the proposed separation into two independent publicly traded companies. Capital return is shifting entirely to dividends while the separation is pending.
items.source_name: Comcast Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Form 8-K, Exhibit 99.1)

items.headline: Bread Financial Q3 net revenue $1,017M; net loss rate 6.40% vs. 7.39%
items.take: Bread Financial reported Q3 2026 total net revenue of $1,017M versus $971M, net income of $156M versus $188M and diluted EPS of $3.82 versus $3.96; the prior-year quarter included a $38M favorable discrete tax item. The net loss rate fell 99 basis points to 6.40%, and the quarterly common dividend rose 9% to $0.25 per share. A prior-year tax benefit larger than the $32M net income decline means the comparison is distorted by that item.
items.source_name: Bread Financial Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Form 8-K, Exhibit 99.1)

items.headline: Synchrony Q3 net earnings $892M, diluted EPS $2.68; net charge-offs 4.79%
items.take: Synchrony reported Q3 2026 net earnings of $892M, down 17% from a year earlier, and diluted EPS of $2.68 versus $2.86. Purchase volume was $49.7B, up 8%, loan receivables were $103.3B, up 3%, and the net charge-off rate was 4.79% versus 5.16%. It returned $1.2B to shareholders, including $1.1B of repurchases and $110M of dividends. Improving charge-offs alongside lower earnings suggest credit losses were not what pulled earnings down this quarter.
items.source_name: Synchrony Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Form 8-K, reported Oct. 20)

items.headline: Initial jobless claims fall to 194,000; continuing claims rise to 1.728M
items.take: The Labor Department reported seasonally adjusted initial claims of 194,000 for the week ended Oct. 17, down 6,000 from a revised 200,000, with the four-week average at 197,750. Insured unemployment rose 25,000 to 1,728,000 for the week ended Oct. 10, and the insured unemployment rate held at 1.1%. Low layoffs paired with a slowly rising continuing-claims count describes a labor market where firing is rare but re-hiring is slow.
items.source_name: U.S. Department of Labor, Unemployment Insurance Weekly Claims

items.headline: Union Pacific Q3 diluted EPS $3.49, up 16%; operating ratio 59.1%
items.take: Union Pacific reported Q3 2026 diluted EPS of $3.49, up 16%, and adjusted diluted EPS of $3.53, up 15%. The operating ratio was 59.1% (58.8% adjusted) and revenue carloads rose 6%. An operating ratio near 59% on higher volume suggests the railroad is converting added carloads into earnings rather than absorbing them as cost.
items.source_name: Union Pacific Q3 2026 earnings release (investor relations)

items.headline: Dover Q3 revenue $2.23B, up 8%; adjusted EPS $2.88 vs. $2.62
items.take: Dover reported Q3 2026 revenue of $2.23B, up 8% from $2.08B a year earlier (7% organic), with GAAP diluted EPS from continuing operations of $2.50 versus $2.20 and adjusted EPS of $2.88 versus $2.62. Its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance is $10.60-$10.75 on revenue growth of 7% to 8%. Organic growth just one point below reported growth means the quarter's sales gain came mostly from the base business rather than acquisitions or currency.
items.source_name: Dover Q3 2026 earnings release

items.headline: Merck KGaA to acquire Silence Therapeutics for $20.00 per ADS in cash, about $1.3B
items.take: Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany agreed to acquire Silence Therapeutics for $20.00 in cash per ADS, an equity value of about $1.3B and an enterprise value of $1.1B, a 130% premium to the Oct. 16 ADS close. It will use a U.K. scheme of arrangement, and closing is expected in the first quarter of 2027, subject to shareholder approval, High Court sanction and regulatory approvals. A premium that size is rare and shows how much value an acquirer attached to one small-cap pipeline.
items.source_name: Silence Therapeutics press release (Oct. 19, 2026)

items.headline: Capital One Q3 diluted EPS $5.61 vs. $4.83; net income $3.5B
items.take: Capital One reported Q3 2026 net income of $3.5B, or $5.61 per diluted share, versus $4.83 a year earlier and $4.73 in Q2; adjusted EPS was $6.69. Total net revenue was $16.3B, up 3% from Q2, the provision was $2.9B including a $225M reserve release, and the preliminary CET1 ratio was 13.8%. A reserve release inside a $2.9B provision shows part of the quarter's profit came from lower expected losses rather than operations.
items.source_name: Capital One Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC 8-K, Ex. 99.1)

items.headline: Cognizant to acquire SAP services firm DyFlex Solutions; terms not disclosed
items.take: Cognizant announced Oct. 21 that it will acquire DyFlex Solutions, an Australia-headquartered SAP Platinum Partner founded in 2011 with over 300 people. Financial details were not disclosed, and closing is expected in the first quarter of 2027, subject to regulatory approvals and customary conditions. Buying a regional SAP specialist rather than building one reflects how IT-services firms are adding capacity in enterprise-software migration work.
items.source_name: Cognizant press release (Oct. 21, 2026)

items.headline: Bank of Canada sets rate announcement and Monetary Policy Report for Oct. 28, 9:45 a.m. ET
items.take: The Bank of Canada will release its interest rate announcement and Monetary Policy Report on Oct. 28 at 9:45 a.m. ET. The Bank sets its overnight rate target on eight scheduled dates a year and publishes the Report, with base-case projections for inflation and growth, four times a year. Because this date carries both, it is a fuller communication than a rate-only decision.
items.source_name: Bank of Canada

items.headline: Honeywell Q3 sales $4,994M vs. $4,929M; adjusted EPS $2.27 vs. $1.70
items.take: Honeywell reported Q3 2026 sales of $4,994M versus $4,929M a year earlier (1% reported, 7% organic). GAAP EPS from continuing operations was $2.40 versus $2.99, which the company attributes primarily to a one-time gain from the Resideo termination agreement in the prior year; adjusted EPS was $2.27 versus $1.70. The gap between 1% reported and 7% organic growth shows how much of the headline sales trend is being shaped by portfolio changes rather than the underlying business.
items.source_name: Honeywell Q3 2026 earnings release

items.headline: Honeywell raises 2026 adj. EPS outlook to $8.40-$8.45 from $8.05-$8.35
items.take: Honeywell now expects 2026 sales of $20.0B-$20.1B (previously $19.8B-$20.0B), adjusted EPS of $8.40-$8.45 (previously $8.05-$8.35) and free cash flow of about $2.1B (previously about $2.0B). Organic growth is now guided at 4%-5% versus 3%-4% before. Every headline guidance metric moved up, with the adjusted EPS midpoint rising about $0.20.
items.source_name: Honeywell Q3 2026 earnings release

items.headline: Norfolk Southern Q3 diluted EPS $3.37 vs. $3.16; operating ratio 67.4%
items.take: Norfolk Southern reported Q3 2026 diluted EPS of $3.37 versus $3.16 and adjusted diluted EPS of $3.62 versus $3.30. The operating ratio was 67.4% versus 64.6%, and the adjusted operating ratio 65.4% versus 63.3%; the company's 2026 adjustments exclude merger-related expenses and the Eastern Ohio incident. EPS rose while the operating ratio worsened, so earnings growth came from higher revenue rather than better cost efficiency.
items.source_name: Norfolk Southern Q3 2026 earnings release

items.headline: Roper Q3 revenue $2,171.8M vs. $2,017.5M; adjusted EPS $5.89 vs. $5.14
items.take: Roper Technologies reported Q3 2026 net revenues of $2,171.8M versus $2,017.5M (up 7.6%) and GAAP diluted EPS of $4.88 versus $3.68. Adjusted diluted EPS was $5.89 versus $5.14, and the company now expects 2026 adjusted EPS of $22.35-$22.40 versus prior guidance of $22.15-$22.30. Adjusted earnings grew faster than revenue, and the raised range lifts the guidance midpoint by $0.15.
items.source_name: Roper Technologies Q3 2026 earnings release

items.headline: FirstService Q3 revenues $1,531.7M vs. $1,447.6M; adjusted EPS $1.89 vs. $1.76
items.take: FirstService reported Q3 2026 revenues of $1,531.7M versus $1,447.6M and adjusted EBITDA of $169.7M versus $164.8M. Adjusted EPS was $1.89 versus $1.76, while GAAP diluted EPS was $0.99 versus $1.24. The release gives no new numeric guidance and reiterates confidence in previously communicated full-year targets.
items.source_name: FirstService Q3 2026 earnings release

items.headline: Vita Coco raises 2026 net sales guide to $810M-$820M; Q3 sales $244M
items.take: Vita Coco reported Q3 2026 net sales of $243.8M versus $182.3M a year earlier (up 34%) and diluted EPS of $0.58 versus $0.40. It raised 2026 net sales guidance to $810M-$820M from $790M-$805M and adjusted EBITDA guidance to $170M-$175M from $154M-$161M. The raised adjusted EBITDA range is about $16M higher at the midpoint, a larger proportional lift than the sales range.
items.source_name: The Vita Coco Company Q3 2026 earnings release

items.headline: Lockheed Martin Q3 sales rise to $20.7B; diluted EPS $7.97 vs. $6.95
items.take: Lockheed Martin reported Q3 2026 sales of $20,711M versus $18,609M a year earlier (11.3% higher) and net earnings of $1,845M versus $1,619M. Diluted EPS was $7.97 versus $6.95, and backlog stood at $291,984M at Sept. 27. Backlog equals about 3.6x the $81B midpoint of the company's 2026 sales outlook, a multi-year order book at the current sales pace.
items.source_name: Lockheed Martin Q3 2026 earnings release

items.headline: Lockheed lifts 2026 EPS outlook to $30.35-$30.75 and free cash flow to $7.8-$8.0B
items.take: Lockheed Martin now expects 2026 diluted EPS of about $30.35-$30.75, up from $29.95-$30.65 in July, and free cash flow of about $7,800-$8,000M, up from $7,000-$7,200M. Sales guidance moved to about $80,000-$82,000M from $79,750-$81,750M. Q3 free cash flow was $2,999M versus $3,347M a year earlier, so the cash raise leans on the rest of the year.
items.source_name: Lockheed Martin Q3 2026 earnings release

items.headline: Quest Diagnostics Q3 revenue up 10.0% to $3.10B; adjusted EPS $3.00 vs. $2.60
items.take: Quest Diagnostics reported Q3 2026 net revenues of $3,097M versus $2,816M (10.0% higher). GAAP diluted EPS was $2.78 versus $2.16 and adjusted diluted EPS was $3.00 versus $2.60. Adjusted EPS grew 15.4%, slower than GAAP EPS growth of 28.7%.
items.source_name: Quest Diagnostics Q3 2026 earnings release

items.headline: Quest raises 2026 adjusted EPS guide to $11.25-$11.35 from $11.05-$11.25
items.take: Quest Diagnostics raised full-year 2026 guidance: net revenues of $12.065B-$12.105B (prior $11.95B-$12.05B), GAAP diluted EPS of $10.21-$10.31 (prior $9.97-$10.17) and adjusted diluted EPS of $11.25-$11.35 (prior $11.05-$11.25). The new revenue range spans $40M, against $100M before. The narrower range signals higher confidence in the full-year outcome.
items.source_name: Quest Diagnostics Q3 2026 earnings release

items.headline: Nasdaq Q3 net revenue $1,481M vs. $1,315M; GAAP EPS $0.96 vs. $0.73
items.take: Nasdaq reported Q3 2026 revenues less transaction-based expenses of $1,481M versus $1,315M (12.6% higher), with solutions revenue of $1,172M versus $1,003M and ARR of $3,365M. GAAP diluted EPS was $0.96 versus $0.73 and non-GAAP diluted EPS was $1.04 versus $0.88. The quarterly dividend declared was $0.31 per share versus $0.27.
items.source_name: Nasdaq Q3 2026 earnings release

items.headline: Pool Corp Q3 sales rise 3.7% to $1.50B; diluted EPS flat at $3.40
items.take: Pool Corporation reported Q3 2026 net sales of $1,504,957 thousand versus $1,451,131 thousand (3.7% higher). Diluted EPS was $3.40 in both years; adjusted diluted EPS was $3.40 versus $3.39. The company confirmed 2026 diluted EPS guidance of $10.66-$10.96 and adjusted diluted EPS of $10.87-$11.17, so sales grew without lifting per-share earnings.
items.source_name: Pool Corporation Q3 2026 earnings release

items.headline: 10-year Treasury yield 5.12% on Oct. 20: 2.77% real, 2.35% breakeven
items.take: The 10-year constant-maturity Treasury yield was 5.12% on Oct. 20, down from 5.19% on Oct. 14, per the Fed's H.15 data on FRED. The 10-year TIPS yield was 2.77% (from 2.84%) and the 10-year breakeven inflation rate was 2.35%, unchanged. The 2-year yield was 4.79%, leaving the 2s10s spread at 33 bp versus 38 bp on Oct. 19. Since Oct. 14, the decline has come in real yields, not inflation compensation.
items.source_name: Federal Reserve H.15 via FRED (DGS10, DFII10, T10YIE, DGS2)

items.headline: FOMC meets Oct. 27-28; the October meeting carries no projections
items.take: The Federal Reserve's 2026 calendar lists the October FOMC meeting for Oct. 27-28. Of the 2026 meetings, March, June, September and December are marked with a Summary of Economic Projections; the October meeting is not. With no new projections, the policy statement is the main written guidance from the meeting.
items.source_name: Federal Reserve Board: FOMC meeting calendars

items.headline: TTM Q3 net sales $1.20B vs. $752.7M; GAAP EPS $0.79 vs. $0.50
items.take: TTM Technologies reported net sales of $1,203.9 million for the quarter ended September 28, 2026, versus $752.7 million a year earlier, a 60.0% increase. GAAP diluted EPS was $0.79 versus $0.50, and adjusted diluted EPS was $1.46 versus $0.67. Book-to-bill was 2.13 in the quarter, per the release.
items.source_name: TTM Technologies Q3 2026 earnings release

items.headline: TTM guides Q4 sales $1.42B-$1.44B; issues preliminary 2027 outlook
items.take: TTM guided fourth-quarter net sales to $1.42-$1.44 billion and non-GAAP EPS to $1.77-$1.83, with full-year 2026 net sales of $4.47-$4.49 billion. Preliminary 2027 guidance is net sales of $6.5-$6.75 billion and non-GAAP EPS of $8.10-$8.90. The company says the Ophir Optics deal and the pending Merlin and ILFA acquisitions are not in the guidance.
items.source_name: TTM Technologies Q3 2026 earnings release

items.headline: Gentherm Q3 product revenues $405.1M vs. $386.9M; GAAP EPS -$0.08
items.take: Gentherm reported third-quarter product revenues of $405.1 million versus $386.9 million a year earlier, up 4.7%. GAAP diluted EPS was $(0.08) versus $0.49, with a net loss of $2.6 million versus net income of $14.9 million; adjusted diluted EPS was $0.33 versus $0.73. The GAAP swing to a loss is the item to watch against modest revenue growth.
items.source_name: Gentherm 2026 Q3 results release

items.headline: Gentherm lifts 2026 revenue guide to $1.825B-$1.925B on Modine unit
items.take: Gentherm raised full-year 2026 product revenue guidance to $1.825-$1.925 billion from $1.55-$1.65 billion in July, and adjusted EBITDA to $210-$230 million from $185-$200 million. The company said the update reflects the expected contribution from Modine Performance Technologies, whose combination with Gentherm it completed on October 1. Acquisition contribution, not organic change, drives the revision.
items.source_name: Gentherm 2026 Q3 results release

items.headline: Lazard Q3 net revenue $814M GAAP vs. $748M; $0.50 dividend declared
items.take: Lazard reported third-quarter GAAP net revenue of $814 million versus $748 million a year earlier, and adjusted net revenue of $805 million versus $725 million. GAAP diluted EPS was $0.26 versus $0.65, and adjusted diluted EPS was $0.36 versus $0.56. Lazard declared a $0.50 quarterly dividend payable November 13 to holders of record on November 2.
items.source_name: Lazard Q3 2026 results release

items.headline: argenx Q3 operating income $1.751B vs. $1.151B; diluted EPS $7.80
items.take: argenx reported total operating income of $1,751 million for the third quarter versus $1,151 million a year earlier, up 52.1%, with profit for the period of $506 million versus $344 million. Diluted EPS was $7.80 versus $5.18. Cash and financial assets totaled $3.7 billion at September 30, after about $2.1 billion paid for the Forte Biosciences acquisition.
items.source_name: argenx Q3 2026 results release

items.headline: Abbott Q3 sales $13.01B, up 14.5%; GAAP EPS $0.53 vs. $0.94
items.take: Abbott reported third-quarter net sales of $13,013 million versus $11,369 million a year earlier, up 14.5% as reported and 7.0% on a comparable basis. Diluted EPS was $0.53 versus $0.94 on a GAAP basis, and $1.42 versus $1.30 adjusted. The gap between GAAP and adjusted EPS is the figure to watch alongside the sales growth.
items.source_name: Abbott Q3 2026 earnings release

items.headline: Abbott reaffirms 2026 adj. EPS $5.50-$5.55; Q4 guide $1.62-$1.67
items.take: Abbott's release gives full-year 2026 adjusted diluted EPS of $5.50 to $5.55, Q4 adjusted diluted EPS of $1.62 to $1.67, and full-year comparable sales growth of about 6.0%. Diagnostics sales were $3,305 million, up 46.7% as reported and 6.4% comparable; the release says the reported figure reflects the Exact Sciences acquisition, which closed March 23, 2026. Medical Devices was the largest segment at $5,826 million.
items.source_name: Abbott Q3 2026 earnings release

items.headline: Getty Realty Q3 revenue $63.0M, up 13.3%; AFFO $0.64/share vs. $0.62
items.take: Getty Realty reported third-quarter total revenues of $62,990 thousand versus $55,591 thousand a year earlier and net earnings of $25,606 thousand versus $23,348 thousand, or $0.40 per share in both periods. FFO was $0.61 per share versus $0.66, while AFFO was $0.64 per share versus $0.62. Revenue growth outpaced the change in per-share AFFO.
items.source_name: Getty Realty Q3 2026 earnings release

items.headline: Getty Realty raises 2026 AFFO guide to $2.53-$2.54; $502.3M invested YTD
items.take: Getty Realty raised its 2026 AFFO guidance to $2.53 to $2.54 per diluted share from $2.52 to $2.54. It invested $297.4 million across 68 properties in Q3 at a 6.9% initial cash yield and $502.3 million year to date at 7.2%. The release cites a committed pipeline of more than $75 million for 29 properties.
items.source_name: Getty Realty Q3 2026 earnings release

items.headline: TTM to acquire MKS's Ophir Optics business for about $650M in cash
items.take: TTM Technologies agreed to acquire the Ophir Optics business from MKS Inc. for approximately $650 million in cash, subject to customary closing adjustments, with closing expected in the second quarter of 2027. TTM's release puts the price at roughly 10.3x expected FY 2027 Adjusted EBITDA of Ophir Optics, without synergies, and the deal excludes the Ophir Instruments laser characterization business. Closing remains subject to regulatory approvals and other customary conditions.
items.source_name: TTM Technologies 8-K, Exhibit 99.1 (Oct. 19, 2026)

items.headline: SpaceX Q3 revenue $14.58B vs. $5.58B; net income $4.40B, diluted EPS $0.35
items.take: SpaceX reported third-quarter revenue of $14,575 million versus $5,576 million a year earlier, net income of $4,404 million versus a $1,054 million loss, and diluted EPS of $0.35 versus $(0.36). Super Intelligence segment revenue was $7,560 million versus $813 million and Connectivity was $5,248 million versus $3,097 million. Segment mix is the story: Super Intelligence and Connectivity together made up about 88% of quarterly revenue.
items.source_name: SpaceX Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC filing)

items.headline: Japan Sept exports up 16.7% to ¥10.97T; imports up 18.9%, deficit ¥536.6B
items.take: Japan's Ministry of Finance provisional data show September exports of ¥10,972,254 million versus ¥9,404,854 million a year earlier and imports of ¥11,508,812 million versus ¥9,682,557 million, leaving a deficit of ¥536,558 million versus ¥277,703 million. Electrical machinery exports rose 30.3% and semiconductors rose 49.4%. Imports grew faster than exports, which is why the deficit roughly doubled.
items.source_name: Japan Ministry of Finance, Trade Statistics (Sept. 2026 provisional), Oct. 21, 2026

items.headline: Globe Life Q3 revenue $1.60B; net operating EPS $4.84 vs. $4.81
items.take: Globe Life reported third-quarter total revenue of $1,595.9 million versus $1,513.0 million a year earlier, net income per diluted share of $4.62 versus $4.73, and net operating income per diluted share of $4.84 versus $4.81. It adjusted full-year 2026 earnings guidance to a range of $15.35 to $15.65. GAAP EPS slipped about 2% while revenue grew about 5.5%.
items.source_name: Globe Life Q3 2026 earnings release (Form 8-K Ex. 99.1), Oct. 21, 2026

items.headline: Old National Q3 EPS $0.66 vs. $0.46; net income to common $250.0M
items.take: Old National reported third-quarter net income applicable to common shares of $250.0 million versus $178.5 million a year earlier and diluted EPS of $0.66 versus $0.46. Total revenue on a fully taxable-equivalent basis was $720.4 million versus $713.0 million, and period-end loans were $51.2 billion. Earnings rose far faster than revenue, about 40% against 1%, so the year-over-year gain came mostly from below the revenue line.
items.source_name: Old National Bancorp 3Q26 earnings release (Form 8-K Ex. 99.1), Oct. 21, 2026

items.headline: Japan Sept mineral fuel imports up 39.4% to ¥2.35T; petroleum up 51.1%
items.take: Japan's September provisional trade data show mineral fuel imports of ¥2,346,269 million, up 39.4% from a year earlier and contributing 6.9 points to total import growth. Petroleum imports rose 51.1% and LNG imports rose 39.2%. Fuel accounted for more of the import increase than any other category named in the release.
items.source_name: Japan Ministry of Finance, Trade Statistics (Sept. 2026 provisional), Oct. 21, 2026

items.headline: Globe Life lifts 2026 buyback to $725M-$775M; 2027 EPS est. $16.10-$17.10
items.take: Globe Life said it repurchased 1.1 million shares in the third quarter at a total cost of $185 million and now expects to spend $725 million to $775 million on repurchases for full-year 2026, compared with prior guidance of $670 million to $700 million. For 2027 it estimates net operating income per share of $16.10 to $17.10. The higher buyback range is a capital-return signal that sits alongside a trimmed 2026 earnings range.
items.source_name: Globe Life Q3 2026 earnings release (Form 8-K Ex. 99.1), Oct. 21, 2026

items.headline: Thermo Fisher Q3 revenue $12.14B, up 9%; GAAP EPS $4.64 vs. $4.27
items.take: Thermo Fisher reported third-quarter revenue of $12.14 billion versus $11.12 billion a year earlier, with organic growth of 6%. GAAP diluted EPS was $4.64 versus $4.27 and adjusted EPS was $6.68 versus $5.79. The gap between reported and organic growth, and between GAAP and adjusted EPS, is worth watching when the company updates 2026 guidance on its call.
items.source_name: Thermo Fisher Q3 2026 earnings release (Form 8-K Ex. 99.1), Oct. 21, 2026

items.headline: Teledyne Q3 net sales $1,684.9M, up 9.4%; outlook raised
items.take: Teledyne reported third-quarter net sales of $1,684.9 million versus $1,539.5 million a year earlier, GAAP diluted EPS of $5.82 versus $4.65, and non-GAAP EPS of $6.72 versus $5.57. It raised full-year 2026 GAAP EPS outlook to $21.71-$21.87 and non-GAAP to $25.40-$25.50. EPS growth outpaced sales growth, roughly 25% GAAP against 9.4% for sales.
items.source_name: Teledyne Q3 2026 earnings release (Form 8-K), Oct. 21, 2026

items.headline: Las Vegas Sands Q3 net revenue $3.22B vs. $3.33B; dividend raised 20% for 2027
items.take: Las Vegas Sands reported third-quarter net revenue of $3.22 billion versus $3.33 billion a year earlier, diluted EPS of $0.48 versus $0.61, and consolidated adjusted property EBITDA of $1.12 billion versus $1.34 billion. It repurchased $950 million of common stock in the quarter and announced a 20% increase in its recurring dividend to $1.44 per share annually for 2027. Returning capital while revenue and EBITDA fell year over year is the contrast in this report.
items.source_name: Las Vegas Sands Q3 2026 earnings release (Form 8-K Ex. 99.1), Oct. 21, 2026

items.headline: Medpace Q3 revenue $716.0M, up 8.5%; backlog up 5.6% to $3.17B
items.take: Medpace reported third-quarter revenue of $716.0 million versus $659.9 million a year earlier and GAAP diluted EPS of $4.84 versus $3.86. Backlog as of Sept. 30 was $3,167.2 million, up 5.6%, and net new business awards were $873.4 million. It forecasts 2026 revenue of $2.835-$2.855 billion; backlog growing slower than revenue is the detail to track.
items.source_name: Medpace Q3 2026 earnings release (Form 8-K Ex. 99.1), Oct. 21, 2026

items.headline: Oceaneering Q3 revenue $785M, up 6%; net income $52.6M, down 26%
items.take: Oceaneering reported third-quarter revenue of $785 million versus $742.9 million a year earlier, net income attributable of $52.6 million versus $71.3 million, and GAAP diluted EPS of $0.52 versus $0.71. Adjusted EBITDA rose 7% to $119 million and free cash flow was $142 million. The company initiated full-year 2027 EBITDA guidance of $430-$480 million.
items.source_name: Oceaneering Q3 2026 earnings release (Form 8-K Ex. 99.1), Oct. 21, 2026

items.headline: SEI board raises stock repurchase program by $800M to about $925.6M available
items.take: SEI Investments disclosed in a Form 8-K that its board on Oct. 20, 2026 approved an additional $800.0 million for its stock repurchase program, raising the available authorization to approximately $925.6 million. The filing was made alongside its third-quarter earnings report for the quarter ended Sept. 30, 2026. Authorizations set a ceiling for buybacks rather than a commitment to execute them.
items.source_name: SEI Investments Form 8-K, Oct. 21, 2026

items.headline: Meta Q3 revenue $64.6B, up 26%; EPS $3.83 includes $9.89B legal charge
items.take: Meta reported third-quarter revenue of $64,601 million versus $51,242 million a year earlier, net income of $9,860 million versus $2,709 million, and diluted EPS of $3.83 versus $1.05. Income from operations was $12,988 million versus $20,535 million, a 20% operating margin versus 40%, with costs including a $9.89 billion charge tied to an agreement with state attorneys general. Free cash flow was negative $2.12 billion, and with 2026 capex guided to $135-$145 billion, spending is the line to watch against Q4 revenue guidance of $73-$76 billion.
items.source_name: Meta third quarter 2026 results release, Oct. 21, 2026

items.headline: Tesla Q3 revenue $28.05B vs. $28.10B; GAAP EPS $0.22 vs. $0.39
items.take: Tesla reported third-quarter revenue of $28,046 million versus $28,095 million a year earlier, GAAP net income of $787 million versus $1,373 million, and GAAP diluted EPS of $0.22 versus $0.39 (non-GAAP $0.48 versus $0.50). Income from operations was $718 million versus $1,624 million, and capital expenditures were $4,732 million versus $2,248 million. Free cash flow fell to $1,531 million from $3,990 million, so the cash-flow gap is tied to higher spending on flat revenue.
items.source_name: Tesla Q3 2026 Update (Exhibit 99.1 to Form 8-K), Oct. 21, 2026

items.headline: BLS: median weekly earnings $1,232 in Q3, up 1.5% vs. CPI up 3.5%
items.take: The Bureau of Labor Statistics reported median usual weekly earnings of full-time wage and salary workers of $1,232 in the third quarter of 2026 (not seasonally adjusted), 1.5% above a year earlier, compared with a 3.5% gain in the Consumer Price Index over the same period. The seasonally adjusted median was $1,239 versus $1,258 in the second quarter, and women's median earnings were 83.4% of men's. Nominal pay growth running below the CPI gain means the typical full-time worker's earnings lost ground in real terms over the year.
items.source_name: BLS Usual Weekly Earnings of Wage and Salary Workers, Q3 2026 (USDL-26-1604)

items.headline: Texas Capital Q3 EPS $2.28 vs. $2.18; total revenue $356.6M
items.take: Texas Capital Bancshares reported third-quarter diluted EPS of $2.28 versus $2.18 a year earlier, net income available to common stockholders of $99.4 million versus $100.9 million, and total revenue of $356.6 million versus $340.4 million. Total assets were $32.35 billion and total deposits $27.72 billion at Sept. 30, 2026. EPS rose while net income to common slipped, which points to a lower share count.
items.source_name: Texas Capital Bancshares third quarter 2026 results release, Oct. 21, 2026

items.headline: BancFirst Q3 EPS $1.97 vs. $1.85; net income $67.3M
items.take: BancFirst reported third-quarter net income of $67.3 million versus $62.7 million a year earlier and diluted EPS of $1.97 versus $1.85. At Sept. 30, 2026, total assets were $15.02 billion, total loans $8.73 billion and total deposits $12.70 billion, versus $14.20 billion, $8.29 billion and $12.12 billion a year earlier. Deposits and loans both grew from a year ago, which supports the earnings gain.
items.source_name: BancFirst Corporation third quarter 2026 earnings release, Oct. 21, 2026

items.headline: IBM Q3 revenue $17.1B, up 5%; operating EPS $2.95 vs. $2.65
items.take: IBM reported third-quarter revenue of $17.1 billion versus $16.3 billion a year earlier, with Software at $7.8 billion (up 8%), Consulting $5.3 billion (flat) and Infrastructure $3.7 billion (up 4%). GAAP diluted EPS from continuing operations was $2.31 versus $1.84, operating EPS $2.95 versus $2.65, and free cash flow $3.0 billion versus $2.4 billion. IBM kept its 4%-5% constant-currency revenue growth outlook and now expects free cash flow to rise by more than $1 billion for the year, which puts the software mix at the center of the story.
items.source_name: IBM third-quarter 2026 results release, Oct. 21, 2026

items.headline: Texas Instruments Q3 revenue $6.06B, up 28%; EPS $2.62; Q4 EPS guide $2.45-$2.79
items.take: TI reported third-quarter revenue of $6.06 billion, net income of $2.43 billion and earnings per share of $2.62; revenue rose 11% sequentially and 28% from a year ago, and operating profit was $2,874 million versus $1,663 million. Trailing-12-month free cash flow was $8.4 billion, and the company guided fourth-quarter revenue of $5.80-$6.30 billion and EPS of $2.45-$2.79. The guidance midpoint implies a modest step down in revenue from the third quarter.
items.source_name: Texas Instruments Q3 2026 earnings release, Oct. 21, 2026

items.headline: CSX Q3 revenue $4.02B, up 12%; net earnings $1.05B, EPS $0.57 vs. $0.37
items.take: CSX reported third-quarter revenue of $4.02 billion, up 12% year over year, with volume of 1.69 million units, 5% higher. Operating income was $1.57 billion versus $1.09 billion and net earnings were $1.05 billion, or $0.57 per diluted share, versus $0.37 a year earlier; the prior-year quarter included a $164 million non-cash goodwill impairment, and excluding it EPS was $0.44. The year-ago impairment flatters the GAAP comparison, so the adjusted prior-year base is the cleaner yardstick.
items.source_name: CSX Corp. Q3 2026 results release, Oct. 21, 2026

items.headline: Reliance Q3 net sales $5.21B, up 42.8%; EPS $7.84 vs. $3.59
items.take: Reliance reported record third-quarter net sales of $5.21 billion versus $3.65 billion a year earlier, with diluted EPS of $7.84 versus $3.59 and non-GAAP EPS of $8.02 versus $3.64. Tons sold were 1,867.2 thousand, up 15.6% from a year ago, and the quarterly dividend was declared at $1.25 a share. Management attributed the results to higher price levels for most carbon steel products, and pricing rather than volume drove most of the year-over-year gain.
items.source_name: Reliance, Inc. Q3 2026 results release, Oct. 21, 2026

items.headline: Crown Castle Q3 AFFO $530M, up 8%; full-year outlook updated
items.take: Crown Castle reported third-quarter AFFO of $530 million, or $1.24 per share, up 8% and 11% from the third quarter of 2025, and site rental revenues of $966 million, down 4.5% year over year. Diluted net income per share was $0.67 versus $0.74. The company raised its 2026 outlook midpoints for Adjusted EBITDA by $25 million and AFFO by $5 million, to $1,980 million for AFFO. The outlook change is small relative to the full-year AFFO figure.
items.source_name: Crown Castle Q3 2026 results release, Oct. 21, 2026

items.headline: Salesforce to acquire Braze for $47.50 a share in cash; enterprise value about $5.66B
items.take: Salesforce signed a definitive agreement on Oct. 19 to acquire Braze, paying $47.50 in cash per Class A share, at an enterprise value of approximately $5.66 billion. Closing is expected in Salesforce's fiscal 2028, which begins Feb. 1, 2027, subject to Braze shareholder approval and regulatory approvals; the merger agreement sets a $300 million fee payable by Salesforce in specified circumstances and $191.39 million payable by Braze. The size of the reverse fee shows how much regulatory risk the parties are pricing into a deal that adds a customer-engagement platform to Salesforce's marketing products.
items.source_name: Salesforce investor relations release, Oct. 20, 2026 (and Braze SEC Form 8-K)

items.headline: UK CPI inflation rises to 3.5% in September from 3.1%; motor fuels lead
items.take: The ONS reported UK CPI inflation of 3.5% in the 12 months to September 2026, up from 3.1% in August, with CPIH at 3.6% and core CPI at 2.8%. Transport was the largest upward contributor at 0.94 percentage points, with motor fuel prices up 29.8% over 12 months versus 23.0% in August; services inflation rose to 3.7% from 3.4%. Core and services rates both rose alongside fuel, so the pickup was not confined to energy.
items.source_name: ONS, Consumer price inflation, UK: September 2026

items.headline: Canada CPI rises 3.1% in September; gasoline up 27.8% from a year ago
items.take: Statistics Canada reported that consumer prices rose 3.1% year over year in September, up from 3.0% in August, with gasoline up 27.8% after a 22.8% rise in August. Excluding gasoline, CPI rose 2.2%, down from 2.4%, and food purchased from stores rose 1.7% versus 2.8% in August. The gap between the headline and ex-gasoline rates shows that fuel is doing nearly all of the work in Canadian inflation right now.
items.source_name: Statistics Canada, The Daily: Consumer Price Index, September 2026

items.headline: Fed H.8: commercial bank loans and leases $14.18T; C&I loans up 10.0% annualized in September
items.take: The Fed's H.8 release of Oct. 16 showed U.S. commercial banks held $26,100.3 billion of total assets, $14,182.5 billion of loans and leases and $19,771.5 billion of deposits in the week ending Oct. 7, seasonally adjusted. For September, deposits grew at a 5.8% annualized rate and bank credit at 3.3%, slowing from 5.0% in August, while commercial and industrial loans grew 10.0%. Business lending growing about three times as fast as total bank credit points to corporate borrowing as the main driver of balance-sheet growth.
items.source_name: Federal Reserve Board, H.8 Assets and Liabilities of Commercial Banks, Oct. 16, 2026

items.headline: Integra LifeSciences Q3 revenue $411.2M, up 2.3%; adjusted EPS $0.59 vs. $0.54
items.take: Integra LifeSciences reported third-quarter revenue of $411.2 million versus $402.1 million a year earlier, GAAP diluted EPS of $0.19 versus a loss of $0.07, and adjusted EPS of $0.59 versus $0.54. Full-year 2026 guidance is revenue of $1.634-$1.654 billion and adjusted EPS of $2.30-$2.40, which the company says is consistent with its Oct. 2 outlook. With guidance unchanged, the quarter's swing from a GAAP loss to a profit is the main change from the prior-year comparison.
items.source_name: Integra LifeSciences Q3 2026 results (GlobeNewswire)

items.headline: RTX Q3 sales rise to $25.0B, 12% organic; 2026 adjusted EPS outlook raised to $7.65-$7.75
items.take: RTX reported third-quarter sales of $24.97 billion versus $22.48 billion a year earlier, with organic growth of 12%, and adjusted EPS of $2.26 versus $1.70. Backlog stood at $340 billion, and the company lifted its 2026 adjusted sales outlook to $97.0-$97.5 billion from $95.0-$96.0 billion. Free cash flow fell to $2.12 billion from $4.03 billion, so the quarter's strength showed up in orders and earnings rather than cash.
items.source_name: RTX Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC 8-K, Ex. 99)

items.headline: GE Aerospace Q3 orders up 49% to $19.0B; 2026 adjusted EPS guide lifted to $8.00-$8.10
items.take: GE Aerospace reported third-quarter orders of $19.0 billion, up 49%, and adjusted revenue of $13.29 billion, up 18%; adjusted EPS rose to $2.25 from $1.66. The company raised its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $8.00-$8.10 from $7.65-$7.85 and free cash flow to $9.1-$9.4 billion. Orders growing far faster than revenue widens the gap between demand and what the company can deliver near term.
items.source_name: GE Aerospace Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC 8-K, Ex. 99)

items.headline: Northrop Grumman backlog reaches $109.6B; Q3 sales up to $11.1B
items.take: Northrop Grumman reported third-quarter sales of $11.12 billion versus $10.42 billion a year earlier and diluted EPS of $7.89 versus $7.67. Backlog rose to $109.6 billion at Sept. 30 from $95.7 billion at the end of 2025, and 2026 MTM-adjusted EPS guidance moved up to $29.35-$29.75 from $28.60-$29.10. A $13.9 billion backlog build in nine months gives the company revenue visibility well beyond the current year.
items.source_name: Northrop Grumman Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC 8-K, Ex. 99)

items.headline: 3M Q3 adjusted EPS $2.50 vs. $2.23; 2026 adjusted EPS guide set at $9.10-$9.15
items.take: 3M reported third-quarter GAAP sales of $6.58 billion versus $6.52 billion, with adjusted organic growth of 3.3%, and adjusted EPS of $2.50 versus $2.23. The company now guides 2026 adjusted EPS to $9.10-$9.15 and adjusted free cash flow to about $4.8 billion. With organic growth in the low single digits, the EPS gain is coming mainly from margins rather than volume.
items.source_name: 3M Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC 8-K, Ex. 99.1)

items.headline: AT&T Q3 revenue rises 5.3% to $32.3B; adjusted EPS $0.65 vs. $0.54
items.take: AT&T reported third-quarter revenues of $32.3 billion versus $30.7 billion and adjusted EPS of $0.65 versus $0.54; diluted EPS fell to $0.13 from $1.29 on a non-cash impairment tied to its held-for-sale Mexico wireless business and separation charges. It reported 379,000 postpaid phone net adds and 442,000 fiber net adds, and its 2026 outlook calls for free cash flow of $18 billion-plus. The gap between GAAP and adjusted EPS this quarter comes from the charges AT&T identified, while adjusted earnings grew.
items.source_name: AT&T Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC 8-K, Ex. 99.1)

items.headline: Fifth Third Q3 diluted EPS $0.90; adjusted $1.13 after $171M merger charges
items.take: Fifth Third reported third-quarter net income to common shareholders of $828 million, or $0.90 a diluted share versus $0.91 a year earlier; excluding certain items, EPS was $1.13. Net interest income was $2.27 billion, and after-tax merger-related charges were $171 million as the bank completed the systems conversion for its Comerica acquisition. With the conversion done, the remaining question is how quickly merger charges fade from reported results.
items.source_name: Fifth Third Bancorp Q3 2026 earnings release

items.headline: Maximus agrees to buy Agile Defense for $660M cash plus up to $50M earnout
items.take: Maximus Federal Services agreed on Oct. 19 to acquire Agile Defense from Arclight Equity Holdings for $660 million in cash, reduced by debt and certain expenses, plus up to $50 million in contingent payments tied to revenue milestones. Closing is expected in Maximus's first quarter of fiscal 2027, and no shareholder vote is required. The earnout structure ties up to about 7.6% of the base price to post-closing revenue performance.
items.source_name: Maximus Form 8-K, Oct. 20, 2026 (Equity Purchase Agreement)

items.headline: September housing starts fall to 1.221M annualized, 7.4% below a year earlier
items.take: Housing starts ran at a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 1,221,000 in September, 5.2% below August's revised 1,288,000 and 7.4% below September 2025, per Census; the monthly drop is not statistically significant. Single-family starts were 859,000, and building permits were 1,400,000, 3.0% below a year earlier. Permits held near August's level even as starts slipped, so the pipeline of approved projects has not shrunk the way groundbreakings have.
items.source_name: U.S. Census Bureau, New Residential Construction, September 2026

items.headline: 30-year mortgage rate holds at 7.40%, up 45 bp in four weeks
items.take: Freddie Mac's 30-year fixed mortgage average was 7.40% for the week ending Oct. 15, unchanged from Oct. 8 and up from 6.95% on Sept. 17. The next reading is due Oct. 22. Rates at this level line up with September's soft starts data.
items.source_name: Freddie Mac PMMS via FRED (MORTGAGE30US)

items.headline: 10-year Treasury yield ends Oct. 19 at 5.15%, up 6 bp from Friday
items.take: The 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield was 5.15% on Oct. 19, up from 5.09% on Oct. 16 and below 5.21% on Oct. 13, per Fed H.15 data on FRED. Long-end yields above 5% keep pressure on mortgage rates and corporate refinancing costs heading into the Oct. 28 FOMC decision.
items.source_name: Federal Reserve H.15 via FRED (DGS10)

items.headline: Total public debt outstanding reaches $40.39T as of Oct. 16
items.take: Total public debt outstanding was $40.388 trillion on Oct. 16, per Treasury's Debt to the Penny data, with $32.532 trillion held by the public and $7.855 trillion in intragovernmental holdings. Debt held by the public, the portion financed in markets, is about 81% of the total and is the portion refinanced through Treasury auctions.
items.source_name: U.S. Treasury, Debt to the Penny (FiscalData)

items.headline: Travelers Q3 EPS rises to $9.04; core EPS up 13% to $9.18
items.take: Travelers reported third-quarter net income of $1.917 billion, or $9.04 a diluted share, versus $1.888 billion and $8.24 a year earlier, while core income rose to $9.18 a share from $8.14. Total revenues were $12.41 billion versus $12.47 billion, and net written premiums were essentially flat at $11.48 billion. With premium growth stalled, the earnings gain came from a shrinking share count and higher investment income rather than a bigger book of business.
items.source_name: Travelers Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC 8-K, Ex. 99.1)

items.headline: Fed balance sheet edges up $8.1B to $6.756T; reserves average $3.02T
items.take: Federal Reserve total assets were $6,755.6 billion on Wednesday, Oct. 14, up $8.1 billion from a week earlier, per H.4.1 data on FRED. Reserve balances averaged $3,022.1 billion in the week, down $7.5 billion on the week but $91.9 billion above the week ended Sept. 23. A flat balance sheet means week-to-week reserve swings are now being driven by Treasury's cash account, not by Fed policy.
items.source_name: Federal Reserve H.4.1 via FRED (WALCL, WRESBAL)

items.headline: Brent's premium over WTI narrows to $24.64 a barrel from $31.92 on Oct. 8
items.take: Brent crude was $126.55 a barrel on Oct. 14 and WTI was $101.91, per EIA spot data on FRED, leaving a $24.64 gap. On Oct. 8 Brent was $130.18 and WTI $98.26, a $31.92 spread; since then Brent fell $3.63 while WTI rose $3.65. A spread this wide signals that the supply shock is concentrated in seaborne international crude, with U.S. inland barrels only partly pulled along.
items.source_name: U.S. Energy Information Administration via FRED (DCOILBRENTEU, DCOILWTICO)

items.headline: Travelers' combined ratio improves to 86.8% despite $538M of catastrophe losses
items.take: Travelers' Q3 combined ratio was 86.8% versus 87.3% a year earlier even as pretax catastrophe losses rose to $538 million from $402 million; the underlying combined ratio, which excludes catastrophes and prior-year reserve development, was 84.1% versus 83.9%. Pretax net investment income rose 6.3% to $1.098 billion, and the company bought back 4.0 million shares for $1.508 billion. The slight drift in the underlying ratio is the number to watch: it suggests pricing is no longer outrunning loss trends by as much as it was.
items.source_name: Travelers Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC 8-K, Ex. 99.1)

items.headline: SOFR at 3.88% sits 2 bp under the Fed's 3.90% reserve rate; RRP use near zero
items.take: The Secured Overnight Financing Rate was 3.88% on Oct. 14, versus 3.89% on Oct. 13, while the interest rate on reserve balances held at 3.90%, per New York Fed and Board data on FRED. Usage of the Fed's overnight reverse repo facility was $1.201 billion on Oct. 15, up from $0.201 billion a day earlier. Repo trading below the reserve rate shows no sign of funding strain, but with the RRP buffer all but empty, any further cash drain will come directly out of bank reserves.
items.source_name: Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Federal Reserve Board via FRED (SOFR, IORB, RRPONTSYD)

items.headline: Treasury's cash at the Fed averages $883.4B, down $93.7B from late September
items.take: The Treasury General Account averaged $883.4 billion in the week ended Oct. 14, up $3.1 billion from the prior week but $93.7 billion below the $977.1 billion average in the week ended Sept. 23, per H.4.1 data on FRED. Reserve balances rose $91.9 billion over the same span. The near one-for-one mirror shows Treasury's cash management, not Fed balance-sheet policy, is setting the week-to-week tone for bank liquidity.
items.source_name: Federal Reserve H.4.1 via FRED (WTREGEN)

items.headline: U.S. regular gasoline averages $4.331 a gallon, down 14.7 cents in three weeks
items.take: EIA's weekly U.S. regular gasoline price was $4.331 a gallon in the week of Oct. 12, down from $4.354 a week earlier and $4.478 on Sept. 21, per FRED. The pullback comes even as Brent remained above $125 a barrel on Oct. 14. Easing pump prices would give October consumer inflation a little relief after gasoline drove September's CPI jump, but the cushion is thin with crude this high.
items.source_name: U.S. Energy Information Administration via FRED (GASREGW)

items.headline: International Seaways agrees to buy Bruton and its four VLCCs, valued at ~$370M
items.take: International Seaways signed agreements on October 16 to acquire Bruton, valued at approximately $370 million: a first-step exchange for about 50.5% of Bruton's shares at 0.05190 INSW shares each, expected to settle around October 20, followed by a merger for the remainder, with roughly 96% of total consideration in stock. AlphaGen read: this is a mostly stock-funded way to add four VLCCs, and the exchanging holders' commitment to vote for the merger leaves Bruton's meeting around October 30 as the main remaining step.
items.source_name: International Seaways Form 8-K (SEC EDGAR)

items.headline: City Therapeutics prices upsized $200M IPO at $18; trading as CTY on Nasdaq
items.take: City Therapeutics priced 11,111,111 shares at $18.00 for gross proceeds of about $200.0 million, with Nasdaq trading under CTY starting October 16 and closing expected October 19. AlphaGen read: the upsizing shows investors are still putting money into clinical-stage RNAi platforms this month.
items.source_name: City Therapeutics press release (GlobeNewswire)

items.headline: Strive prices $630M upsized IPO of 15% SATS perpetual preferred
items.take: Strive priced 7,000,000 shares of 15.00% Series A Perpetual SATS Preferred Stock at $90.00, up from 5,000,000 shares, for about $630 million gross, settling October 20, with a Nasdaq listing under SATS applied for. AlphaGen read: the 15% coupon on a $100 liquidation preference is an expensive source of capital, and Strive names bitcoin purchases among the uses of proceeds.
items.source_name: Strive pricing term sheet, Form FWP (SEC EDGAR)

items.headline: Scanntech raises $180M Series F led by L Catterton, with Partners Group co-leading
items.take: Latin American retail intelligence platform Scanntech announced a $180 million Series F led by L Catterton, with Partners Group co-leading and Bradesco and SPX participating, subject to closing conditions and regulatory approvals. AlphaGen read: this is a large growth round for a Latin American data business, backing a point-of-sale network that the company says covers more than 80% of retail sell-out in its markets.
items.source_name: Scanntech press release (PR Newswire)

items.headline: Truist Q3 EPS falls to $0.56 on a $1.4B securities loss; adjusted EPS $1.16
items.take: Truist reported third-quarter net income available to common shareholders of $0.68 billion, or $0.56 a diluted share, versus $1.04 a year earlier, as total revenue fell to $3.75 billion from $5.19 billion. Excluding a $0.90-a-share loss on AFS securities sales, a $0.36-a-share reserve recapture and $0.06 of impacts tied to the sale of Regional Acceptance Corporation loans, adjusted EPS was $1.16; taxable-equivalent net interest income rose to $3.71 billion and the margin was 3.00%. The quarter is a deliberate reset rather than an operating miss: adjusted ROTCE of 14.6% versus 7.2% reported shows how much of the hit was one-time.
items.source_name: Truist Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC 8-K, Ex. 99.1)

items.headline: Truist sells RAC loans and releases $581M of reserves
items.take: Truist recorded a $253 million provision benefit, including a $581 million release of remaining allowance tied to Regional Acceptance Corporation, while the RAC sale pushed the net charge-off ratio to 0.77%, of which 39 basis points relate to RAC, including $251 million of charge-offs on the transfer to held for sale. The RAC sale accounted for $5.5 billion of a $5.9 billion drop in period-end loans held for investment, and preliminary CET1 eased to 10.7% from 10.9% in the second quarter after $1.2 billion of buybacks. Moving a book with elevated losses off the balance sheet means future charge-off ratios should be read against a smaller, different loan base.
items.source_name: Truist Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC 8-K, Ex. 99.1)

items.headline: Citizens Q3 EPS rises to $1.41 from $1.05 on a 12.6% jump in net interest income
items.take: Citizens Financial reported third-quarter net income of $636 million and diluted EPS of $1.41, versus $494 million and $1.05 a year earlier, on total revenue of $2,322 million versus $2,118 million. Net interest income rose to $1,675 million from $1,488 million as the net interest margin widened to 3.18% from 2.99%, while the provision fell to $125 million from $154 million. Margin expansion is doing the heavy lifting here, with expenses up only modestly at $1,393 million versus $1,335 million.
items.source_name: Citizens Financial Q3 2026 financial supplement (SEC 8-K, Ex. 99.3)

items.headline: Euro-area inflation at 3.8% in September in final data, up from 3.2%
items.take: Eurostat put euro-area annual HICP inflation at 3.8% in September, up from 3.2% in August and 2.2% a year earlier; EU inflation was also 3.8%. Energy contributed 1.71 percentage points and services 1.52 points, with services inflation at 3.2% versus 3.0% in August. The services uptick matters more for the ECB than the energy spike, because it is the part of inflation that policy rates are meant to lean against.
items.source_name: Eurostat: Euro indicators, HICP September 2026 (16 October 2026)

items.headline: Regions Q3 EPS of $0.71, up 16%, as margin widens to 3.68%
items.take: Regions reported third-quarter net income available to common shareholders of $611 million, or $0.71 a diluted share, which it said was up 11% and 16% from a year earlier; adjusted EPS was $0.73. Total revenue rose to $1,973 million from $1,916 million, with net interest income of $1,298 million versus $1,257 million and a 3.68% margin versus 3.59%. Revenue growth of about 3% is modest, so the earnings gain rests largely on lower credit costs.
items.source_name: Regions Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC 8-K, Ex. 99.1)

items.headline: M&T Q3 EPS climbs to $5.04 even as net income slips to $775M
items.take: M&T Bank reported third-quarter diluted EPS of $5.04 versus $4.82 a year earlier, although net income fell to $775 million from $792 million. Taxable-equivalent net interest income rose to $1,805 million from $1,773 million, but the margin narrowed to 3.65% from 3.69%, and estimated CET1 fell to 10.16% from 10.99% after $323 million of buybacks in the quarter. Per-share growth on lower profit is a buyback story, and the lower capital ratio limits how long that lever can run at this pace.
items.source_name: M&T Bank Q3 2026 results release (M&T investor relations)

items.headline: Euro-area energy prices up 18.9% on the year in September
items.take: Eurostat's final September data show euro-area energy prices up 18.9% year over year, versus 14.3% in August, with a 4.0% month-on-month rise; energy alone added 1.71 percentage points to 3.8% headline inflation. Among large economies, national rates were 5.0% in Spain, 4.2% in Italy, 3.4% in France and 3.3% in Germany. The spread across countries reflects how differently energy costs pass through to households, which complicates a single ECB response.
items.source_name: Eurostat: Euro indicators, HICP September 2026 (16 October 2026)

items.headline: Regions' net charge-offs fall to 0.29% of loans from 0.55% a year ago
items.take: Regions reported third-quarter net charge-offs of $72 million, an annualized 0.29% of average loans, versus $135 million and 0.55% a year earlier. Average loans rose to $99.2 billion from $96.6 billion, while average deposits were roughly flat at $129.1 billion versus $129.6 billion. Halving losses while loans grew points to a cleaner credit book, though flat deposits leave funding growth as the constraint.
items.source_name: Regions Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC 8-K, Ex. 99.1)

items.headline: September import prices at 8:30 a.m. and industrial production at 9:15 a.m. today
items.take: BLS publishes U.S. Import and Export Price Indexes for September at 8:30 a.m. ET today, and the Federal Reserve releases its G.17 industrial production and capacity utilization report at 9:15 a.m. ET. After this week's producer-price data, import prices will show how much of the energy shock is arriving from abroad, and the output report will show whether factories are absorbing higher costs or cutting back.
items.source_name: BLS release schedule (October 2026); Federal Reserve G.17 release dates

items.headline: M&T average loans rise 5.4% to $143.3B; charge-offs ease to 0.35%
items.take: M&T's average loans rose to $143,296 million in the third quarter from $135,890 million a year earlier, and average deposits rose to $166,777 million from $162,576 million. Net charge-offs fell to an annualized 0.35% of average loans from 0.42%, while the provision rose to $135 million from $125 million. Loan growth at this pace alongside easing losses shows a lender still finding demand to put capital to work, not just protecting it.
items.source_name: M&T Bank Q3 2026 results release (M&T investor relations)

items.headline: Portugal picks Lufthansa to buy 44.9% of TAP for €1.025B
items.take: Portugal's government selected Lufthansa Group's offer of EUR 1.025 billion for a 44.9 percent stake in TAP Air Portugal, rising to up to EUR 1.2 billion for 49.9 percent; Lufthansa expects to sign the agreements shortly, with completion subject to regulatory approval. AlphaGen read: this gives Lufthansa a minority foothold in TAP's Atlantic network, and the regulatory reviews are the remaining gate.
items.source_name: Lufthansa Group press release

items.headline: Siemens leads nine-figure round valuing Skeleton Technologies above $1B
items.take: Skeleton Technologies says a nine-figure round led by Siemens lifts its valuation above $1 billion; the money mainly funds U.S. manufacturing expansion, and the company plans to invest more than $200 million in scale-up and R&D in Silicon Valley. AlphaGen read: a strategic lead from Siemens links Skeleton's supercapacitor tech more tightly to data-center power demand, though the round size was not disclosed.
items.source_name: Skeleton Technologies press release

items.headline: Hulic tenders at ¥295 a share to take Riso Kyoiku private
items.take: Hulic, holder of 50.87% of Riso Kyoiku Group, launched a tender offer at 295 yen per share running October 14 to November 26, 2026, aiming to make the company a wholly owned subsidiary and delist it. AlphaGen read: it adds to the run of Japanese parent-subsidiary buyouts as groups simplify listed structures.
items.source_name: Riso Kyoiku Group tender offer announcement

items.headline: Nokia agrees to sell Enterprise Campus Edge unit to AURELIUS
items.take: Nokia signed a definitive agreement to sell its Enterprise Campus Edge private-wireless business, serving nearly 900 customers, to AURELIUS; terms were not disclosed and closing is expected in the first half of 2027. AlphaGen read: the carve-out continues Nokia's portfolio narrowing, moving a niche enterprise unit to a carve-out specialist.
items.source_name: Nokia press release

items.headline: ECB's Schnabel to leave the Executive Board on Jan. 3, 2027 for an IMF role
items.take: The ECB's Governing Council agreed with its Ethics Committee on Sept. 24 that Isabel Schnabel's planned IMF role, starting Jan. 4, 2027, raised no conflict-of-interest concerns, so no cooling-off period applies; she resigned from the ECB effective Jan. 3, 2027, according to the Council's non-rate decisions published Oct. 2. The same release shows collateral and haircut guideline changes taking effect Nov. 30. Schnabel's exit opens one of the six Executive Board seats just as euro-area policy is wrestling with an energy-driven inflation shock, making the succession a policy story as much as a personnel one.
items.source_name: European Central Bank: Decisions taken by the Governing Council (2 October 2026)

items.headline: CBO pegs the FY2026 federal deficit at $2.0T, $218B wider than FY2025
items.take: The Congressional Budget Office estimates the fiscal 2026 deficit at $2.0 trillion, $218 billion more than in fiscal 2025. Revenues rose an estimated $169 billion, or 3%, while outlays climbed $386 billion, or 6%, led by net interest on the debt, major benefit programs, defense and education. With spending growth running at twice the pace of receipts and interest costs among the leaders, Treasury supply pressure on the long end is unlikely to ease into fiscal 2027.
items.source_name: Congressional Budget Office: Monthly Budget Review, September 2026

items.headline: CFTC seeks comment on rules for retail crypto trades and a 'crypto asset market'
items.take: The CFTC issued an advance notice of proposed rulemaking on 'Regulation Crypto Asset Transactions' and 'Regulation Crypto Asset Markets,' covering retail commodity transactions in crypto assets under section 2(c)(2)(D) of the Commodity Exchange Act, including a proposed designated-contract-market subcategory called a 'crypto asset market.' Comments are due 60 days after Federal Register publication. An ANPRM is the earliest stage of rulemaking, but it signals the CFTC intends to build a dedicated venue framework for retail crypto spot-style trading rather than regulate it case by case.
items.source_name: CFTC Press Release 9307-26

items.headline: BoE flags gilt repo leverage; policy proposals due in early 2027
items.take: Bank of England executive director Nathanaël Benjamin said 'doing nothing is not an option' on gilt repo resilience and that 'out-of-control leverage is unwelcome,' with a comprehensive update and potential policy proposals planned for early 2027. He cited Bank research estimating that more central clearing could have cut gilt repo exposures on UK dealer balance sheets by 40% to 60% during the 2020 'dash for cash.' Central clearing and tighter haircuts would raise the cost of leveraged basis trades, a risk worth watching for hedge-fund demand at gilt and, by extension, Treasury auctions.
items.source_name: Bank of England: Speech by Nathanaël Benjamin (ISDA forum)

items.headline: BoE reserve balances slip £3.6B to £645.9B; short-term repo at £132.1B
items.take: Reserve balances at the Bank of England fell to £645.9 billion in the week to Oct. 14 from £649.6 billion a week earlier, while short-term repo lending eased to £132.1 billion from £133.4 billion, per the Bank's weekly report. The loan to the Asset Purchase Facility was unchanged at £521.8 billion. Repo usage of more than £130 billion shows banks are leaning steadily on Bank facilities as quantitative tightening drains reserves.
items.source_name: Bank of England Weekly Report, 14 October 2026

items.headline: Meta will report Q3 results after the close on Oct. 21
items.take: Meta Platforms said it will release third-quarter 2026 results after market close on Wednesday, Oct. 21, with a conference call at 4:30 p.m. ET. Its capital-spending commentary will be an early read on how large platforms are budgeting for AI infrastructure into 2027.
items.source_name: Meta Investor Relations

items.headline: Jio Platforms files IPO prospectus; all-primary issue of up to 270M shares
items.take: Jio Platforms' red herring prospectus dated October 14 covers a fresh issue of up to 270,000,000 equity shares with no offer for sale; anchor bidding is October 19 and the public issue runs October 21-23, with listing on BSE and NSE. AlphaGen read: with no selling shareholders, the offering is a pure capital raise for the company, and the size of the syndicate signals how much global distribution is being lined up.
items.source_name: Jio Platforms Red Herring Prospectus

items.headline: TKO goes public with $2.0B cash bid for Service Properties Trust hotels
items.take: TKO LLC said its October 7 letter of intent offers $2.0 billion in cash for SVC's hospitality portfolio, that it has had no meaningful response, and that it will put $50 million in escrow once SVC signs an NDA. AlphaGen read: it is an unsolicited, non-binding approach, so the next marker is whether SVC's board engages or discloses other bids.
items.source_name: TKO LLC press release (PR Newswire)

items.headline: TCGX Acquisition Corp. II prices $100M shares-only SPAC IPO
items.take: TCGX Acquisition Corp. II sold 10,000,000 Class A shares at $10.00 for $100 million, with Nasdaq trading under TCXB from October 16 and no warrants or over-allotment option. AlphaGen read: dropping warrants trims dilution for a future healthcare target and reflects a cleaner SPAC structure.
items.source_name: TCGX Acquisition Corp. II press release (Business Wire)
